name: x3d-stem-kerr2/v1
purpose: Kerr 2 · The Photon Ring (x3d.STEM flagship 1). Accepting under it means: the scene is grammatical and meaningful on the fork with no known trap; every case declares its model and limits; the analytic critical curve, sub-ring refinement, constraint, unresolved-ray, colour and clipping witnesses are present, consistent and green; payloads decode; and each bank was produced by the shipped builder. Eyes: a browser frame of every case matches the offline render of the same payloads (correlation at least 0.98, mean difference at most 4/255) with a signal floor and a flipped negative control that must fail. Behaviour, GPU location and paired visual review stay visible as not run.
limitations: Page traps are static pattern and syntax checks of src/*.js against the X_ITE contracts the Loom has paid for (law 32); the page's browser evidence remains the behaviour witness.
Eyes is one headless Chromium on one machine (Apple M3, ANGLE Metal), one view per case; behaviour, GPU and visual-review witnesses did not run.
Builder binding covers tools/kerr2.py only, not modules it imports (common.py, color.py).
Grammar and Meaning ran on the local x3d_mcp fork checkout, not the family pin.
Unsigned receipt: it shows drift; it does not authenticate authorship.
